purpose: separate capacity, model-generation, and quantization effects on typed semantic candidate proposal after the V88r1 and V89 negative results

population.selectionOrder: strata in registered order; within each stratum ascending SHA-256 of salt, service, active intent, and canonical record ID; skip any dialogue already selected
population.futureRecordUse: evaluation only; never use for prompt selection, examples, tuning, training, retries, or manual adjudication

inputContract.dialogueContext: all source turns from dialogue start through the selected USER turn
schemaContext: all service intent identifiers and descriptions
all service slot identifiers and descriptions

systemPrompt: You are an offline semantic candidate proposer. Your output is permanently non-deployable and cannot select an action or call a service. Infer the current typed state for the target service from the complete dialogue history and the supplied schema. Return exactly one JSON object with exactly two keys: intent_candidates and state_slot_key_candidates. intent_candidates must be a unique non-empty JSON list using only the supplied intent identifiers or NONE, and must always include NONE as an operational none-of-the-above candidate. Include the smallest set of currently plausible active intents; when no supplied intent is active, return only NONE. state_slot_key_candidates must be a unique JSON list using only supplied slot identifiers; include every slot whose current accumulated value is supported by the dialogue, but never emit a slot value. Do not emit prose, Markdown, actions, service calls, arguments, values, confidence scores, or additional keys.

outputContract.intentCandidates: unique non-empty list drawn only from target service intent identifiers plus mandatory NONE
outputContract.stateSlotKeyCandidates: unique list drawn only from target service slot identifiers
outputContract.goldIntentCandidateSet: NONE only for a NONE state; otherwise active intent plus NONE
outputContract.goldStateSlotKeySet: accumulated frame.state.slot_values keys at the selected turn

controls.exhaustiveEnumeration: all service intents plus NONE and all service slots
controls.noneOnly: NONE intent only and empty state
controls.emptyStateWithGoldIntentOracle: gold intent candidates with no state keys

registeredMetrics: mandatory NONE inclusion and NONE-only exactness
active-intent coverage and exact candidate set
latency, prompt tokens, generated tokens, and peak active memory

combinationDiagnostic.method: fail-closed canonical set union of independently ontology-conformant rows only; retain NONE; no new generation

decisionRule.completedCondition: all 48 independent generations complete within access gates regardless of quality outcome
decisionRule.qualifyingCondition: every noncompensatory quality and access gate passes
decisionRule.ifNo27BConditionQualifies: retain model-free authoritative boundary and freeze all new models as nonqualifying shadow evidence
decisionRule.ifAny27BConditionQualifies: select the lowest-weight qualifying 27B condition for a separately preregistered posterior-integration shadow study only
decisionRule.ifCombinationDiagnosticPasses: authorize only preregistration of a bounded small-first or union shadow comparison
